long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Istanbul in 1973, Sabancı studied business administration at Marmara University before taking roles across the family group. She joined Sabancı Holding's board, returned after a short interval and remained until a professional representative took the family seat. Her principal wealth remains tied to inherited interests in the diversified Sabancı group.

Outside the conglomerate, Sabancı serves as vice chair of Vista Tourism and has maintained a substantial equestrian career. She founded S International Equestrian Center in 2005, later served as a Turkish Equestrian Federation vice president and competed as a show jumper. She subsequently won a national adult pro-rider title. These activities give her a public identity beyond family shareholding while remaining secondary to the inherited investment base.

A 2023 general-interest article claimed that Sabancı had sold a roughly 40-metre yacht, while the authoritative input retains S7 as current and specialist yacht sources list S7 for sale in 2026 after refits. The article did not identify a hull and no completed current S7 sale was verified. The conflict is recorded rather than used to overwrite the authoritative relationship.

The upstream record uses the ASCII form Sevil Sabanci. Official Turkish corporate filings and Forbes often use the extended legal style Sevil Sabancı Sabancı, while the official family biography and public usage use Sevil Sabancı. Only the diacritic correction to the concise canonical public form is proposed; the repeated legal surname is retained as an alias observation rather than forced into owner fields.
